title: Fore-edge
description: A plain cloth octavo with a gilt edge. Draw your thumb across the edge and the leaves fan in steps, the gold breaks into hairlines, and a Turner seascape opens across the strips of page between them. Let go and it closes flush under the gold again. Fore-edge paintings were painted on the fanned leaves and then gilded over, so the picture hides in the edge itself.
intent: Factory run 4, the only idea to score 8 from both critics. One object holding a secret that a held gesture reveals.
sources: Painting: J. M. W. Turner, The Shipwreck (1805), public domain
